Name: 78. Subsets

Name: 150. Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
Algorithm: Use stack, iterate over tokens if token is a num push it to the stack, if token is an operator then pop 2 values from stack and to operation.

Name: 134. Gas Station
Algorithm: Calculate the difference between cost and gas into an array. Solution to the problem exist only if sum of gas array is greater then sum of cost array. Considering fact that solution exist, iterate over differenece array and sum the elements, if the sum became negative, reset the starting point, if the sum became positive, remember starting point. Return starting point as result

Name: 7. Reverse Integer
Algorithm: Use % operation in order to detemine one digit and then divide the number by 10, in order to move to the next digit. Summarize digit with previous sum multiplied by 10. Check whether previous sum stays in a limits of (Int.MAX / 10) .. (Int.MIN / 10)

Name: 43. Multiply Strings
Algorithm: Create 2 functions: one to add strings and second to multiply with char (or single int digit). Then take original number and replace a multi-digit multiplication to addition and multiplication with single digit

Name: 543. Diameter of Binary Tree
Algorithm: Iterate with dfs, for each node calculate the depth of left subtree and depth of right subtree. The diameter is the sum of both heights. Track max sum for each node.

Name: 1448. Count Good Nodes in Binary Tree
Algorithm: Iterate with dfs, track max value between visited nodes. If max value <= node value, then current node is blue. Then continue dfs call for left and right node recursively.

Name: 853. Car Fleet
Algorithm: Sort cars by position, iterate from end to start and calculate the travel time = distance / speed. Iterate over from end to start, if current travel time is bigger then travel time of previous car, then it will make a new fleet, otherwise it will be in the fleet of previous car.
